name: tilt-gizmo-simple
description: Simple ladder for the in-viewport 3D tilt gizmo handle (PARITY-TILT tail). Editing gizmos only mount inside the per-room editor (canEditScene), so the scenario enters the livingDining room editor first. Verifies the tiltFurniture flag is OFF in Simple / ON in Pro (same flag gates the inspector sliders + the gizmo), seeds + selects a floor lamp, projects the gizmo ball's world position to screen pixels via the dev __three camera, drags it with synthetic pointer events, and confirms the item's pitch/roll changed in the store + the release armed the tick/cross pendingEdit. Screenshots before/after from two camera angles (front + side profile).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: room-editor-active

steps.name: seed-and-select
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setItems([{ id: 'tilt-gizmo-lamp', defId: 'floor-lamp', position: [10.5, 4.1], rotation: 0, props: {} }]); s.selectItem('tilt-gizmo-lamp'); })()

steps.name: compute-handle-screen-pos
steps.eval: (() => { function applyM4(x,y,z,e){ const w=1/(e[3]*x+e[7]*y+e[11]*z+e[15]); return [ (e[0]*x+e[4]*y+e[8]*z+e[12])*w, (e[1]*x+e[5]*y+e[9]*z+e[13])*w, (e[2]*x+e[6]*y+e[10]*z+e[14])*w ]; } function worldToClient(wx,wy,wz){ const cam=window.__three.camera; cam.updateMatrixWorld(); const dom=window.__three.gl.domElement; const v1=applyM4(wx,wy,wz,cam.matrixWorldInverse.elements); const v2=applyM4(v1[0],v1[1],v1[2],cam.projectionMatrix.elements); const rect=dom.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: rect.left+(v2[0]*0.5+0.5)*rect.width, y: rect.top+(1-(v2[1]*0.5+0.5))*rect.height }; } window.__worldToClient = worldToClient; window.__tgt = worldToClient(10.5, 2.14, 4.1); })()

steps.name: handle-onscreen

waitFor.store: (() => { const r=window.__three.gl.domElement.getBoundingClientRect(); const t=window.__tgt; return t && t.x>=r.left && t.x<=r.right && t.y>=r.top && t.y<=r.bottom; })()

steps.failMessage: projected gizmo-ball screen position fell outside the canvas — camera framing or anchor-height math drifted

steps.name: grab-handle
steps.eval: (() => { const dom=window.__three.gl.domElement; const t=window.__tgt; const opt=(x,y)=>({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,pointerId:9,pointerType:'mouse',isPrimary:true,button:0,buttons:1,clientX:x,clientY:y}); dom.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', opt(t.x, t.y))); })()

steps.name: gizmo-grabbed
steps.failMessage: pointerdown on the projected ball position did not grab the tilt gizmo (rotatingGizmo never set)

steps.name: tilt-changed

waitFor.store: (() => { const it=state.items.find(i=>i.id==='tilt-gizmo-lamp'); if(!it) return false; return Math.abs((it.pitch||0)-window.__t0.pitch) > 1e-4 || Math.abs((it.roll||0)-window.__t0.roll) > 1e-4; })()

steps.name: orbit-to-side-profile
steps.eval: (() => { const c=window.__three.controls; const cam=window.__three.camera; const t=c.target; const dx=cam.position.x-t.x, dz=cam.position.z-t.z; cam.position.set(t.x+dz, Math.max(1.2, cam.position.y*0.55), t.z-dx); c.update(); })()
